declarations.description: A web component to display stereographic pictures on web pages, with VR support.
declarations.name: StereoImg

members.name: src
members.description: Source of the stereo picture (absolute or relative).

members.name: srcRight
members.description: Source of the right eye picture for the "pair" type. The left eye picture is read from "src".

members.name: type
members.description: Type of stereo picture: "vr", "left-right", "right-left", "top-bottom", "bottom-top", "interlaced", "interlaced-reverse", "column-interlaced", "column-interlaced-reverse", "pair", "mpo", "lif", "anaglyph" (or "anaglyph-red-cyan", "anaglyph-red-green", "anaglyph-red-blue", "anaglyph-green-magenta", "anaglyph-amber-blue" to name its colours), "depth" or "mono". If unset, the type is inferred from heuristics.

members.name: angle
members.description: Hint at the angle of view, in degrees between 0 and 360. If unset, the Exif angle of view is used if present.

members.name: projection
members.description: Hint at the projection: "equirectangular" or "fisheye". If unset, the projection is inferred from heuristics.

members.name: disparityAdjustment
members.description: Distance to add between the pictures of the two eyes, in percent of the width of one of them. A negative value moves them closer together.

members.name: flat
members.description: Display mode when viewing in 2D: "left" (default), "right", "wiggle" or "anaglyph".

members.name: controlslist
members.description: Space-separated list of controls to display: "vr", "left", "right", "wiggle", "anaglyph" and "sound". All are displayed by default.

members.name: debug
members.description: When set, logs diagnostic information to the console and displays the wireframe of the 3D geometry.

members.name: wiggle
members.description: Alternate between the left and right images.
members.deprecated: Use the "flat" attribute with a value of "wiggle" instead.

members.name: muted
members.description: When set, the sound of the picture does not start by itself when entering VR.

events.name: next
events.description: In VR, the viewer asks for the next picture: with the trigger of the right controller, a pinch of the right hand, the button of a Cardboard viewer, or a thumbstick pushed to the right.

events.name: previous
events.description: In VR, the viewer asks for the previous picture: with the trigger of the left controller, a pinch of the left hand, or a thumbstick pushed to the left.
